Food
Jul 2025 • Family
Capos is an exceptional Spanish restaurant with a warm, welcoming ambiance and authentic cuisine. The tapas are flavorful and beautifully presented—especially the patatas bravas and garlic prawns. Their paella is rich, perfectly cooked, and full of fresh seafood. The sangria is a must-try, refreshing and well-balanced. The staff is attentive, knowledgeable, and adds to the overall wonderful dining experience. The atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, making it perfect for both date nights and group dinners. Prices are reasonable for the quality you receive. Capos truly delivers a taste of Spain—highly recommended for anyone craving delicious Spanish food and great service!
